Long ago, the goddess issued the Divine Purge, wiping out every man in existence. Women were granted unbearably long lives and bodies free from illness. In this age of darkness, the goddess created the world's only man—Anik, the Envoy of Light. The holy essence within him holds the power to purify women defiled by demons, making him the world's last hope. It also makes him the target for all sorts of evil powers who wish to claim him.
